spans.title: The Grandfather of All Parrots
spans.blurb: Two wanderers on a silent shore meet an ancient parrot that fixes them with knowing eyes, then shrieks words in a tongue no living person can name.

spans.title: The Bolted Door
spans.blurb: A traveler wakes in the dark to the door he bolted swinging open, and something enormous with a misshapen head slipping quietly inside.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows the night attack that the book builds toward as a creeping suspicion about what happens to guests of a treacherous host.

spans.title: The Goddess Wakes
spans.blurb: In a lost palace a thief stands over a woman dead for a thousand years. Then color touches her cheeks and her lashes begin to lift.

spans.title: The Haunter of the Pits
spans.blurb: Handed a dagger by a stranger, a prisoner steps out of his cell into a vast darkness where something huge and silent is smelling out his trail.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the hero is imprisoned partway through the book and escapes the dungeon with a smuggled dagger.

spans.title: The Hillman's Parley
spans.blurb: A governor holding seven tribesmen hostage summons their chieftain to parley. The man arrives through the window, knife first, and the night takes a wilder turn.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the queen's incognito visit to the frontier fort and her abduction, the book's early pivotal turn.

spans.title: He May Yet Be Saved
spans.blurb: A storm hurls a great ship against a cliff and grinds it to splinters. Then a watching boy spots one man still alive among the waves.

spans.title: The Face at the Window
spans.blurb: On a grey afternoon a woman steps into the dining room and finds a familiar face at the window, close to the glass, staring straight in.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the apparition's return and the narrator's certainty that it has come for someone else, an early key development of the book.

spans.title: The Crash in Chelsea
spans.blurb: An aeroplane falls out of a May morning and a tangled parachute lands on a studio roof. Neighbors, painters and police scramble, but one man never comes upstairs.

spans.title: The Cowardly Lion
spans.blurb: A great lion bounds into the road and bowls over her friends, until a small girl slaps his nose and hears a very surprising confession.

spans.title: The Kalidahs
spans.blurb: A gulf too wide to leap blocks the forest road, then a second, then two beasts with bodies like bears and heads like tigers close in.

books.pairNote: Two separate episodes from different stretches of the same journey, with no shared text and no repeated payoff.

spans.title: The Poisoned Dish
spans.blurb: An emperor takes a few mouthfuls at dinner, feels his heart rise, and grows suspicious. The cooks go under guard while a dog tells the truth.
